description: This file provides functions to get and set cached Astronomical Picture of the Day (APOD) data in a database. It interacts with SQLAlchemy ORM models and performs database queries and updates related to caching APOD data.

classes.name: APODCache
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing a cached APOD entry in the database.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None get_cached_apod(db: Session, apod_date: date, hd: bool)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached APOD record for a specific date and HD preference from the database.

methods.name: None set_cached_apod(db: Session, apod: dict[str, Any], hd: bool)
methods.description: Inserts or updates a cached APOD record in the database based on the provided data.

ctags.name: get_cached_apod
ctags.pattern: /^def get_cached_apod(db: Session, apod_date: date, hd: bool) -> dict[str, Any] | None:$/

ctags.name: set_cached_apod
ctags.pattern: /^def set_cached_apod(db: Session, apod: dict[str, Any], hd: bool) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, apod: dict[str, Any], hd: bool)
